objective: Add deterministic explicit Observation aging inside the World Model so accepted spatial facts transition from observed to stale to lost at an injected reduction boundary, stale or lost evidence cannot confirm completion or safety, and audit values remain replayable without hidden clock reads, background rewrites or public contract changes.
decision_supported: Can the World Model deterministically age entity and relation observations at an explicit as_of boundary, fail closed for incomparable clocks, and prevent expired spatial evidence from confirming a verifier result?
outputs: A World Model-owned explicit Observation freshness policy with finite stale and lost thresholds per evidence class and entity type.
An immutable explicit aging boundary carrying as_of and clock classification without reading hidden process time.
Deterministic aged internal WorldState and public snapshot projections that preserve last values and evidence.
A shared verifier gate that prevents stale, lost or clock-incomparable facts from confirming completion or safety.
A bounded scripted-demo migration that supplies deterministic Observation time and aging context.
Unit, integration and cross-process replay evidence.
acceptance: Normal: an Observation whose age is strictly less than its stale_after threshold remains observed; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_fresh_observation_remains_observed.

Boundary: an Observation becomes stale at age exactly equal to stale_after and becomes lost at age exactly equal to lost_after; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_exact_stale_and_lost_thresholds.

Normal: the freshness policy requires explicit finite stale_after and lost_after rules per evidence class and entity type, with zero less than stale_after and stale_after less than or equal to lost_after; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_policy_requires_explicit_bounded_rules.

Failure: a deployment override that increases either threshold is rejected, while equal or smaller thresholds are accepted; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_deployment_policy_can_only_tighten.

Normal: aging is calculated only from an explicitly supplied as_of boundary and never calls datetime.now, time.time, monotonic or sleep; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_aging_requires_explicit_boundary_without_hidden_clock_reads.

Failure: reducer and apply_event states containing an Observation cannot confirm or refute through a verifier until an explicit freshness policy and aging boundary have been applied; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_unaged_public_reducer_and_apply_event_cannot_confirm.

Boundary: a Python producer may supply the existing ClockId.WALL enum inside a WorldEvent Observation payload and it is normalized to the comparable wall string instead of being discarded; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_clock_id_enum_remains_comparable.

Failure: missing Observation time, missing clock classification, unknown policy tuple, malformed time, a future Observation relative to as_of or an incompatible clock fails closed and cannot confirm; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_missing_or_incomparable_time_fails_closed.

Failure: persisted monotonic timestamps without a serialized common origin are never subtracted across replay and fail closed; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_monotonic_without_serialized_origin_fails_closed.

Normal: stale and lost entities retain their last pose, location, confidence, attributes, last_observed_at and evidence references for audit; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_aging_preserves_audit_value_and_evidence.

Failure: stale and lost facts return insufficient_evidence with stale_observation and re_observe instead of confirmed; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_all_verifiers_reject_stale_and_lost_support and tests/unit/test_world_model.py.

Normal: a newer accepted comparable Observation replaces the observation boundary, supplies new evidence and restores observed when it is inside the fresh interval; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_newer_observation_restores_observed.
Failure: a later-sequence but older comparable Observation cannot refresh or confirm an entity; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_out_of_order_observation_cannot_refresh_state.

Failure: ACTION_RESULT events remain replayable execution evidence but cannot modify last_observed_at, observation clock metadata or belief age; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_action_result_does_not_refresh_observation_age.

Boundary: a relation belief is no fresher than its supporting subject and object entities and cannot remain observed when a required endpoint is lost; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_relation_belief_cannot_outlive_required_entities.

Normal: the same validated event log, explicit policy and explicit as_of boundary produce byte-identical beliefs and state_hash values in two independent Python processes; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_same_boundary_replays_identically_across_processes.

Boundary: changing as_of across an exact stale or lost threshold changes schema-visible beliefs and state_hash, while replay at the same boundary remains stable; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_aging.py::test_boundary_changes_belief_and_hash_deterministically.

Regression: deterministic verification identity continues to use the aged snapshot state_hash and remains independent of verified_at wall time; covered by tests/unit/test_world_model_verification_identity.py.

Integration: demo_scripted supplies explicit wall-clock Observation times, an explicit fixture-only freshness policy and an explicit deterministic as_of boundary, while verified_at remains separate diagnostic metadata; covered by tests/integration/test_observe_plan_act.py::test_scripted_demo_uses_explicit_aging_boundary.
Boundary: no interfaces schema, shared Pydantic contract, event-store schema, Agent Runtime, Perception, Motion, robot control, firmware, deployment or safety configuration is modified.

data_classification: Repository-internal source, deterministic simulated Observation fixtures, clock metadata and non-sensitive evidence references.
model_policy: Use only repository evidence and explicit human-approved policy inputs. Do not invent production freshness thresholds, clock origins, loss encodings or cross-module contract semantics.
risks_and_fallbacks: No repository source defines exact stale_after and lost_after production thresholds. The bounded implementation therefore requires an explicit policy and provides no permissive wildcard default; scripted values are fixture-only and are not physical deployment claims.
The existing Observation schema has clock_id but no clock-origin identifier. UTC wall timestamps can be replayed across processes; monotonic timestamps without a persisted common origin fail closed.
Legacy simplified Observation WorldEvents may lack observed_at or clock_id. They remain auditable but are not eligible to confirm under explicit aged reduction; no automatic migration is included.
The public VerificationResult reason vocabulary has stale_observation but no target_lost. Both stale and lost use stale_observation unless a separately approved interface change adds a distinct code.
Issue #165 ages accepted World Model facts but does not implement Issue #72 ingestion validation or Issue #151 post-action orchestration.
The work is stacked on Issue #62 commit 78fd69839c7ad2c27fb2cb7593e8b957cdda60ab and must be retargeted or rebased if the lower stack changes.
tools/scripts/demo_scripted.py is a bounded Integration-owned producer migration and the PR must explicitly invite the Integration Owner and pywh4taz5n.
Rollback consists of reverting the #165 commit. No event-store schema or persisted event migration is introduced.
